entries: {DISASTER:strikes} was remembered in {place}, and {first} heard it first at {landmark}.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and knew it was not forgotten.
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, asking {first} to come to {landmark}.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} appeared {MANNER}, and {first} was the only one to see.
The {rival} wanted {landmark} sold, and {first} heard {SOMEONE:human,!plural} refuse.
{SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} and asked {first} to stay.
{first} was called to {landmark}, where {DISASTER:strikes} had left {THING} behind.
